events.event_name: FIT × Waldorf Astoria New York: Celebration of NYFW
events.brand: Waldorf Astoria New York × Fashion Institute of Technology
events.address: Waldorf Astoria New York, 301 Park Ave, New York, NY 10022
events.what_it_is: A public NYFW exhibition in the Waldorf Astoria New York corridors spotlighting evening gowns by emerging Fashion Institute of Technology designers, with Art Deco, craftsmanship and hoop-dress themes.
events.what_is_free: Public viewing of the fashion exhibition is free.
events.caveats: The Waldorf Astoria's official experiences page explicitly lists the exhibition as open to the public September 1–20. The official calendar does not publish daily exhibition hours, so no opening/closing time is invented here. A separate private FIT Circle tour is not the same admission path as this public exhibition.
events.practical_notes: Open to the public through Sunday, September 20 in the Waldorf Astoria New York's Peacock Alley/Lexington Avenue corridor exhibition area. No reservation requirement is published for ordinary exhibition viewing.
